current_workflow_pr.what: The handoff may name the MERGE BASE with main, which survives a squash merge. A branch head does not, so a handoff naming one names a dead object on main -- five consecutive merges failed that way.
current_workflow_pr.note: check_doc_claims' SHA pattern required backticks, so it could not see a commit id written inside a JSON string -- every hash in the machine mirror was invisible to a gate that was reading that file. One had been dead there for six months. Closing it moved the sha count from 36 to 42.
